title: OpenIRN — Santé API et sécurité
description: Disponibilité, trafic, latence, sécurité et ressources de l'instance OpenIRN supervisée.

config.content:
# OpenIRN — Santé API et sécurité

Vue opérationnelle sur 24 h, actualisée chaque minute. Cibles : disponibilité synthétique ≥ **99,9 %**, latence API p95 < **250 ms**, aucune réponse **5xx**. Les identités et adresses du flux sécurité sont exclusivement des pseudonymes HMAC.

data_source.query:
FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.name == "openirn-api"
| EVAL is_up = CASE(monitor.status == "up", 1.0, 0.0)
| STATS availability_raw = AVG(is_up) * 100
| EVAL availability_pct = ROUND(availability_raw, 3)
| KEEP availability_pct

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95)
| EVAL p95_ms = ROUND(p95_ns / 1000000, 1)
| KEEP p95_ms

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND url.path != "/health"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND http.response.status_code >= 500
| STATS errors_5xx = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS security_events = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS distinct_sources = COUNT_DISTINCT(openirn.security.source_address_hash)

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = http.response.status_code
| SORT time

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS p50_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 50), p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL p50_ms = ROUND(p50_ns / 1000000, 1), p95_ms = ROUND(p95_ns / 1000000, 1)
| KEEP time, p50_ms, p95_ms
| SORT time

FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.name == "openirn-api"
| EVAL is_up = CASE(monitor.status == "up", 1.0, 0.0)
| STATS availability_pct = AVG(is_up) * 100 BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), action = event.action
| SORT time

config.title: Routes hors health les plus sollicitées

data_source.query:
FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND url.path != "/health"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY route = url.path
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND openirn.security.reason IS NOT NULL
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY reason = openirn.security.reason
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 10

config.content:
## Ressources de l'hôte OpenIRN et MariaDB

Points de vigilance : CPU > **85 %**, mémoire > **90 %**, partition racine > **85 %**, connexions ou threads MariaDB en hausse durable.

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-system.cpu-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL cpu_pct = ROUND(system.cpu.total.norm.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP cpu_pct

FROM metrics-system.memory-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL memory_pct = ROUND(system.memory.actual.used.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP memory_pct

FROM metrics-system.filesystem-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND system.filesystem.mount_point == "/"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL disk_pct = ROUND(system.filesystem.used.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP disk_pct

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP mysql.status.threads.connected

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP mysql.status.threads.running

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP mysql.status.aborted.connects
